comment: Closed registry of host-recorded terminal-NO kinds (remediation plan Phase 0.2). Each kind carries its class: 'signal' is a NO-relevant terminal the acceptance instrument rewards as an early NO; 'bound' is excluded from the NO-relevant set so the deadline knob cannot manufacture the terminal event the instrument rewards. Additions are data-file diffs visible in git; record_no.sh refuses a kind absent from this file (a deliberate host action with an unknown kind is a caller bug, not a death signal to preserve).
